name: cert-manager
author: Sextant
description: cert-manager's Certificates, CertificateRequests, Issuers, ClusterIssuers, Orders and Challenges with their state and reasons, the issuance chain Certificate → CertificateRequest → Order → Challenge, and plain-language explanations of the common failures; problems of Certificates that are not ready, fail to renew, expire soon or have expired.
